title: Minimum Average Difference
description:
For each index, compare the floor average of the prefix ending there with the floor average of the remaining suffix. The suffix average is zero when empty. Return the index with the smallest absolute difference; choose the smallest index on a tie.

## Examples

```text
Input: nums = [2,5,3,9,5,3]
Output: 3
```

```text
Input: nums = [0]
Output: 0
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= nums.length <= 10^5`
- `0 <= nums[i] <= 10^5`
